-- [AnimePlayer: ui themes] script-message-to uosc set-theme <name> | set-accent <name|rrggbb> | reset-theme. Applied live (colors are read on every render) and
-- remembered in <config>/uosc_theme.json. Menu: Anime Build Options > UI Theme / Accent Color.
do
	local themes = {
		amber    = {foreground = 'fb8c00', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = '101218', background_text = 'ffffff', success = 'fb8c00'},
		violet   = {foreground = '7c6cf0', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = '14111f', background_text = 'ffffff', success = '7c6cf0'},
		ocean    = {foreground = '3ea0ff', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = '08131f', background_text = 'ffffff', success = '3ea0ff'},
		emerald  = {foreground = '22c58b', foreground_text = '04140d', background = '0a1512', background_text = 'ffffff', success = '22c58b'},
		sakura   = {foreground = 'ff7eb6', foreground_text = '2a0a18', background = '1b1018', background_text = 'ffffff', success = 'ff7eb6'},
		crimson  = {foreground = 'ef4455', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = '170d0f', background_text = 'ffffff', success = 'ef4455'},
		midnight = {foreground = '8ab4ff', foreground_text = '0b0e19', background = '0b0e19', background_text = 'ffffff', success = '8ab4ff'},
		mono     = {foreground = 'e8e8e8', foreground_text = '000000', background = '121212', background_text = 'ffffff', success = 'e8e8e8'},
		light    = {foreground = '5b4cd6', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = 'f4f4f8', background_text = '15151a', success = '5b4cd6'},
	}
	local accents = {orange = 'fb8c00', red = 'ef4455', pink = 'ff7eb6', purple = '7c6cf0', blue = '3ea0ff', cyan = '22d3ee', green = '22c58b', yellow = 'facc15', white = 'f2f2f2'}
	local theme_path = mp.command_native({'expand-path', '~~/uosc_theme.json'})
	local current = {theme = 'amber', accent = nil}
	local loaded = false

	local function apply()
		local base = themes[current.theme] or themes.amber
		local c = {}
		for k, v in pairs(base) do c[k] = v end
		if current.accent then c.foreground = current.accent; c.success = current.accent end
		for k, v in pairs(c) do config.color[k] = serialize_rgba(v).color end
		fg, bg = config.color.foreground, config.color.background
		fgt, bgt = config.color.foreground_text, config.color.background_text
		if request_render then request_render() end   -- not defined yet while main.lua is still loading
	end
	local function save()
		local f = io.open(theme_path, 'w')
		if f then f:write(utils.format_json({theme = current.theme, accent = current.accent}) or '{}'); f:close() end
	end
	local f = io.open(theme_path, 'r')
	if f then
		local data = utils.parse_json(f:read('*all') or '')
		f:close()
		if type(data) == 'table' then
			if themes[data.theme] then current.theme = data.theme; loaded = true end
			if type(data.accent) == 'string' and data.accent:match('^%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then current.accent = data.accent:lower(); loaded = true end
		end
	end
	if loaded then apply() end   -- first run: the uosc.conf colors stay untouched

	mp.register_script_message('set-theme', function(name)
		if not themes[name] then return end
		current.theme, current.accent = name, nil
		apply(); save()
	end)
	mp.register_script_message('set-accent', function(name)
		local hex = accents[name] or tostring(name or ''):gsub('^#', '')
		if not hex:match('^%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return end
		current.accent = hex:lower()
		apply(); save()
	end)
	mp.register_script_message('reset-theme', function()
		current.theme, current.accent = 'amber', nil
		apply(); save()
	end)
end

-- [AP11: watched] map of finished files, written by ap-watched.lua
ap_watched = {}
mp.observe_property('user-data/ap/watched', 'native', function(_, value) ap_watched = type(value) == 'table' and value or {} end)
-- [AP15: hidden queue copy] playlist entries (by id) that the Playlist tab must not show: the queue video staged as "next"
function ap_norm_path(p) return ((p or ''):lower():gsub('\\', '/')) end   -- same key as ap-watched.lua publishes (case / slash insensitive)
ap_durs = {}   -- [AP17: row lengths] normalised path -> seconds, published by ap-queue.lua
mp.observe_property('user-data/ap/durations', 'native', function(_, value) ap_durs = type(value) == 'table' and value or {} end)
function ap_fmt_time(sec)
	sec = math.floor(sec + 0.5)
	local h, m, s = math.floor(sec / 3600), math.floor(sec % 3600 / 60), sec % 60
	if h > 0 then return string.format('%d:%02d:%02d', h, m, s) end
	return string.format('%d:%02d', m, s)
end
ap_hidden = {}
ap_playlist_real = {}   -- row number in the Playlist tab -> real playlist index (1-based); differs while an entry is hidden
mp.observe_property('user-data/ap/hidden', 'native', function(_, value) ap_hidden = type(value) == 'table' and value or {} end)
function ap_real(row) return ap_playlist_real[row] or row end
mp.observe_property('user-data/ap/playlist-footer', 'string', function() if request_render then request_render() end end)

-- [AnimePlayer: ui themes] AP7: real themes = palette + shape (corner radius, text outline) + transparency + timeline look, not just a colour.
-- script-message-to uosc set-theme <id> | set-accent <name|rrggbb> | reset-theme. Applied live and remembered in <config>/uosc_theme.json.
-- The theme is re-applied every time uosc re-reads its options (script-opts changes from ap-responsive / PiP used to wipe it).
do
	local RED = 'c8202c'
	local function T(c, shape) shape.colors = c; return shape end
	-- [AP8: themed close button] a red that belongs to the theme but is never the accent colour (set per theme below, `close`)
	local themes = {
		amber = T({close = 'd93f3f', foreground = 'fb8c00', foreground_text = '000000', background = '101218', background_text = 'ffffff', curtain = '000000'},
			{radius = 8, text_border = 1.5, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 2,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.42, submenu = 0.42, controls = 0.05, slider = 0.3, speed = 0.3, title = 0.27, timeline = 0.27}}),
		ocean = T({close = 'e8546a', foreground = '3ea0ff', foreground_text = '04111f', background = '08131f', background_text = 'e8f3ff', curtain = '02070d'},
			{radius = 12, text_border = 1.2, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 3,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.4, submenu = 0.4, controls = 0.06, slider = 0.3, speed = 0.3, title = 0.27, timeline = 0.27}}),
		violet = T({close = 'e0508f', foreground = '9b87ff', foreground_text = '120d2a', background = '14111f', background_text = 'f1edff', curtain = '07050f'},
			{radius = 14, text_border = 1, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 2,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.42, submenu = 0.42, controls = 0.07, slider = 0.3, speed = 0.3, title = 0.27, timeline = 0.27}}),
		emerald = T({close = 'e8664a', foreground = '22c58b', foreground_text = '04140d', background = '0a1512', background_text = 'e6fff5', curtain = '020806'},
			{radius = 4, text_border = 0.8, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 2,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.4, submenu = 0.4, controls = 0.06, slider = 0.3, speed = 0.3, title = 0.27, timeline = 0.27}}),
		sakura = T({close = 'd6334f', foreground = 'ff7eb6', foreground_text = '2a0a18', background = '2a1722', background_text = 'fff0f6', curtain = '12060d'},
			{radius = 20, text_border = 1, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 4,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.4, submenu = 0.4, controls = 0.07, slider = 0.28, speed = 0.28, title = 0.25, timeline = 0.25}}),
		crimson = T({close = 'ff7a3d', foreground = RED, foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = '140a0c', background_text = 'fff1f1', curtain = '050101'},
			{radius = 2, text_border = 2, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 3,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.42, submenu = 0.42, controls = 0.06, slider = 0.3, speed = 0.3, title = 0.27, timeline = 0.27}}),
		redblack = T({close = '5a0d12', foreground = 'd9202e', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = '000000', background_text = 'ffffff', curtain = '000000'},
			{radius = 6, text_border = 2, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 2,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.45, submenu = 0.45, controls = 0.08, slider = 0.32, speed = 0.32, title = 0.29, timeline = 0.29}}),
		midnight = T({close = 'e5566b', foreground = '8ab4ff', foreground_text = '0b0e19', background = '0b0e19', background_text = 'ffffff', curtain = '000000'},
			{radius = 0, text_border = 0.6, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 1,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.4, submenu = 0.4, controls = 0.04, slider = 0.28, speed = 0.28, title = 0.25, timeline = 0.25}}),
		mono = T({close = 'c62828', foreground = 'f2f2f2', foreground_text = '000000', background = '000000', background_text = 'ffffff', curtain = '000000'},
			{radius = 0, text_border = 2.2, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 2,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.45, submenu = 0.45, controls = 0.08, slider = 0.32, speed = 0.32, title = 0.29, timeline = 0.29}}),
		light = T({close = 'd32f2f', foreground = '5b4cd6', foreground_text = 'ffffff', background = 'f4f4f8', background_text = '15151a', curtain = 'ffffff'},
			{radius = 10, text_border = 0, timeline_style = 'bar', timeline_line_width = 3,
			 opacity = {menu = 0.55, submenu = 0.55, controls = 0.12, slider = 0.4, speed = 0.4, title = 0.36, timeline = 0.36}}),
	}
	local accents = {orange = 'fb8c00', red = RED, pink = 'ff7eb6', purple = '9b87ff', blue = '3ea0ff', cyan = '22d3ee', green = '22c58b', yellow = 'facc15', white = 'f2f2f2'}
	local theme_path = mp.command_native({'expand-path', '~~/uosc_theme.json'})
	local current = {theme = 'amber', accent = nil}
	local saved_file = false

	function lighten_hex(hex)
		local function ch(i) return math.min(255, math.floor(tonumber(hex:sub(i, i + 1), 16) * 1.25 + 28)) end
		return string.format('%02x%02x%02x', ch(1), ch(3), ch(5))
	end
	local function contrast_text(hex)
		local r, g, b = tonumber(hex:sub(1, 2), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(3, 4), 16), tonumber(hex:sub(5, 6), 16)
		return (0.299 * r + 0.587 * g + 0.114 * b) > 150 and '000000' or 'ffffff'
	end

	-- `live` = a user action (also refresh shape + rebuild the controls); false = called from update_config (options were just re-read)
	local function apply(live)
		local base = themes[current.theme] or themes.amber
		local c = {}
		for k, v in pairs(base.colors) do c[k] = v end
		if current.accent then c.foreground = current.accent; c.foreground_text = contrast_text(current.accent) end
		c.success = c.foreground
		c.error = RED
		local close_hex = base.colors.close or RED
		if close_hex == c.foreground then close_hex = '8f1a22' end   -- never the same as the accent
		AP_CLOSE = {bg = serialize_rgba(close_hex).color, hover = serialize_rgba(lighten_hex(close_hex)).color}
		c.close = nil
		for k, v in pairs(c) do config.color[k] = serialize_rgba(v).color end
		fg, bg = config.color.foreground, config.color.background
		fgt, bgt = config.color.foreground_text, config.color.background_text
		for k, v in pairs(base.opacity) do config.opacity[k] = v end
		options.border_radius = base.radius
		options.text_border = base.text_border
		options.timeline_style = base.timeline_style
		options.timeline_line_width = base.timeline_line_width
		if update_display_dimensions then pcall(update_display_dimensions) end
		if live and Elements and Elements.trigger then pcall(function() Elements:trigger('options') end) end
		if request_render then request_render() end   -- not defined yet while main.lua is still loading
	end
	AP_THEME_REAPPLY = function() if saved_file then apply(false) end end
	local function save()
		local f = io.open(theme_path, 'w')
		if f then f:write(utils.format_json({theme = current.theme, accent = current.accent}) or '{}'); f:close() end
		saved_file = true
	end
	local f = io.open(theme_path, 'r')
	if f then
		local data = utils.parse_json(f:read('*all') or '')
		f:close()
		if type(data) == 'table' then
			if themes[data.theme] then current.theme = data.theme; saved_file = true end
			if type(data.accent) == 'string' and data.accent:match('^%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then current.accent = data.accent:lower(); saved_file = true end
		end
	end
	if saved_file then apply(false) end   -- no saved theme yet: the uosc.conf look stays untouched

	mp.register_script_message('set-theme', function(name)
		if not themes[name] then return end
		current.theme, current.accent = name, nil
		saved_file = true; apply(true); save()
	end)
	mp.register_script_message('set-accent', function(name)
		local hex = accents[name] or tostring(name or ''):gsub('^#', '')
		if not hex:match('^%x%x%x%x%x%x$') then return end
		current.accent = hex:lower()
		saved_file = true; apply(true); save()
	end)
	mp.register_script_message('reset-theme', function()
		current.theme, current.accent = 'amber', nil
		saved_file = true; apply(true); save()
	end)
end
